proposals.evidence: The explicit kk extension lists Lahnda lohkā, Awankari laùkā and Punjabi lauhkā for light/small. The survey lokkā/lokā and Gujari masculine/feminine loko/lokī fit that contracted regional family, with source consonant quantity preserved. Both slash members share the same lexical parent.
